content: queue.upsertJobScheduler(schedulerId, repeatOpts, jobTemplate) both creates and updates a named repeatable-job scheduler idempotently -- calling it again with the same schedulerId updates the existing schedule's repeat options/template rather than creating a duplicate competing schedule (matches this repo's existing partition-maintenance.worker.ts precedent). repeatOpts can use 'every' (fixed interval) for cadence-based ticks like a ~5min reconciler, or 'pattern' (cron) for fixed-wall-clock-hour ticks. Jobs produced by a scheduler get an internally-managed job id; you cannot supply a custom jobId for the produced jobs, only for the schedulerId itself.
